title: Separate mutable skeleton construction from immutable runtime representation
description:
Bounded code-health follow-up for the derived skeleton layer. Bone currently exposes public mutable fields and Skeleton exposes a mutable List<Bone>; this makes it possible for downstream consumers to alter derived state after inference and before/after snapshot capture. Replace the current builder-side mutation surface with a narrow construction API or internal builder while preserving SkeletonSnapshot as the authoritative runtime compatibility boundary.

## Scope
- Keep CreatureDefinition/resolved snapshot semantics unchanged.
- Inventory all Bone/Skeleton construction and mutation call sites before changing APIs.
- Introduce an internal construction boundary or immutable constructed skeleton model.
- Preserve deterministic IDs, parent links, positions, rotations, terminal joints, mirroring, and snapshot ordering.
- Add negative tests proving consumers cannot mutate completed skeleton state through normal public APIs.

## Non-goals
- No synthetic locomotion root.
- No new animation abstraction.
- No change to bone naming semantics.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Production consumers cannot mutate a completed skeleton through public fields/list storage.
- Skeleton inference remains transactional and produces byte/semantic-equivalent snapshots.
- Existing animation, IK, binding, and editor tests remain green.
- Migration does not create a second skeleton authority.

## Validation
Runtime/test builds plus focused SkeletonSnapshot, SkeletonInferrer, CreatureRig, and semantic resolver tests. Unity validation required before Done because the runtime hierarchy is downstream of this contract.

comments.body: Takeover audit identified a durable encapsulation risk: Bone is a mutable public-field class and Skeleton exposes a mutable List<Bone>. Current inference intentionally needs mutation while constructing derived state, so a direct readonly-field rewrite would be broad and brittle. Track the migration separately; the preferred direction is an internal builder/construction surface feeding the existing immutable SkeletonSnapshot runtime boundary.
